name: cal-06-hardware-a
version_tag: CALENDAR (shiura 7035937 Ver.2) — flat hardware: foot, cap, separator, nut. FULL SIZE, single colour black, no purge. Split from the tall hardware (cal-07) purely by footprint, not function. VARIANT CHOICES: plain 'foot' not 'foot-short' (114mm vs 84mm; short appears to be the compact-stand option), and see cal-07 for the axis tight/loose call. SUPPORTS: shiura says a few parts in the set need them and does not say which. enable_support is 0 here, so compose's grounded-check will REFUSE this plate rather than print it badly if any of these four has mid-air geometry — that refusal is the diagnostic, not a failure to work around. If it fires, re-spec only the offending part with supports rather than turning them on plate-wide. Layout leaves >=30mm between bodies: foot [70,80] x36-104 y23-137, cap [180,80] x140-220 y40-120, separator [180,190] x140-220 y150-230, nut [60,190] x43-77 y174-206. SPEEDS: stock 0.20mm Standard.
